# Memmy v1.2.7

## Highlights

- Expanded project collaboration with shared tasks, project instructions, knowledge lookup, invitations, and clearer local-to-cloud project sharing.
- Unified recording views and conversation-scoped recording cards, with improved playback, transcript navigation, and retained audio when transcription fails.
- Refined the home page and the connections/tools hub, including project-aware files, connection status, filtering, and a single project-creation dialog per window.

## Project collaboration

- Reuse an existing linked cloud project when the same local project is shared again, and keep one local-project association when rebinding.
- Show project identifiers in selection and conflict messages so supported project-management commands can distinguish projects with the same name.
- Serialize collaboration link writes and preserve background upload progress while keeping local selections and project bindings consistent.
- Restore completed onboarding after reinstall and preserve cloud-controlled demo eligibility.
- Improve board header hit areas, project sharing feedback, and coordination between launch prompts and collaboration onboarding.
- Remove the cross-device member-assistance workflow from the desktop collaboration experience. Shared project tasks and project knowledge remain available.

## Recordings and desktop

- Keep recording cards scoped to their owning conversation and provide a consistent recording/transcript view.
- Preserve captured audio when transcription fails, show recovery status, and improve recording archive and summary delivery flows.
- Repair WebM duration metadata and improve playback and transcript navigation.
- Restore the sidebar recording shortcut after viewing an existing recording and improve recording-panel width and navigation.
- Scope the task file panel to the selected project and refine home recommendations, tool filters, and connection presentation.

## Agent, runtime, and reliability

- Improve OpenAI-compatible Responses protocol negotiation, reasoning and tool-call continuity across session reloads, and streaming output handling.
- Repair Windows Memory startup and plugin activation when optional upload or recording directories do not yet exist.
- Keep the backend available when launch-specific MCP configuration is temporarily locked, and refresh Agent connections after both bridge entries have been updated.
- Retain managed TeX and Office rendering support while moving Office runtime preparation into the background, with download, extraction and verification progress. Operations that need native tools wait for preparation.
- Revalidate Windows local-reader consent checks when file permissions change.

## Upgrade notes

- Desktop, Agent, Backend, and native application metadata use `1.2.7`. The Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned at `2.1.7`.
- In a shared project, new task drafts default to sharing with project members. Turn sharing off before the first message to keep that task local; existing tasks retain their saved sharing state.
- Stopping project sharing keeps the local project and its tasks, and saves its shared background and guidelines locally. Rebinding changes the local association without deleting the previous cloud project.
- Office runtime preparation may still be needed on first native use. The MCP configuration recovery above applies to the bridge-writing stage, not every earlier configuration migration.
- Installation, in-place upgrade, signed-package acceptance, independent review, and publication remain separate release checks. Final package artifacts must be traced to the reviewed release candidate.
